For Infect terms, the blue base bar is around −23.7, while the fine-tuned bars are near roughly −23.0 to −23.3, with the darkest brown around −23.3. For Neuro terms, the blue base bar is around −25.4 and the fine-tuned bars are approximately −24.2 to −24.7, with the darkest brown near −24.7. For Obstetrics terms, the blue base bar is around −24.7 and the fine-tuned bars fall around roughly −23.8 to −24.1, with the darkest brown near −24.1. For Pediatrics terms, the blue base bar is around −24.7 and the fine-tuned bars are around roughly −23.4 to −24.0, with the darkest brown near −24.0.
